owner_correction.C3: Sheet A, loose side-parted shoulder-length curls, open blue parka, burgundy inner top, buttoned ivory waistcoat and belt with twin pouches.
owner_correction.C4: Sheet B, rounded dark curls and black headband, small hoops, closed blue-and-orange parka over dark turtleneck, tall lace-up boots.
owner_correction.shared: Compact silhouettes, rounded brown gloves, blue coats with orange trim and cream cuffs. Front, sides and back of the actual owner sheets govern geometry and colors. Do not add an intrinsic expedition pack when the supplied back is clear.

current_reference_bytes: The original four-view designs were provided in the owner conversation. The standalone three-panel front guide is a derivative; the original owner sheets remain the authority on hidden surfaces and proportions.

front_reference_derivative.description: Reframed front-view guides derived by design lead from this conversation’s three four-view uploads. These are front-view generation guides. The original owner uploads remain the authority on cut, proportions and occluded surfaces.
front_reference_derivative.method: Colored surface extent, threshold max RGB minus minimum RGB > 19, in the three respective front panels. These bounded measures describe the derived image only.

literal_four_view_notes.source: Direct visual and approximate bounding-box comparison by the lead with the three literal inline four-view uploads, 2026-11-27
literal_four_view_notes.C2: Hood back is flat coat blue with subtle midline stitching below cream fur. An orange panel or painted geometric marks is a wrong material. Approximate original front mitten span / height 0.83.
literal_four_view_notes.C3: Approximate original front mitten span / height 0.82.
literal_four_view_notes.C4: Original shown horizontally from approximately x70 to 467 and vertically from y64 to 570 in the lead viewing surface. Approximate front mitten span / height 0.785. The matching raw model spans about 0.794.
literal_four_view_notes.uncertainty: Approximate original outline estimates depend on the exact floor row, lateral anti-alias, foreshortening and camera. The literal four views control.

C2.runtime_notes: Exact compact body, blue hood and rebuilt sleeve lengths in frozen project

C3.runtime_notes: Exact coat and waistcoat, rebuilt sleeve lengths in frozen project

C4.runtime_notes: Exact headband, tall laced boots and original compact sleeve span in frozen project

final_runtime.C2_hood: The raw orange/blue motif was replaced by the blue material, subdued center seam and matching normal/roughness on the final runtime skin. See C2-hood-before-after.jpg.
final_runtime.viewing_note: The original studio key produced brighter gold highlights. The final comparison uses neutral white lights and linear tone mapping for all three characters. Original gameplay crops are unchanged.

design_read.C2: Asymmetric bob, dark glasses and large hoops. Orange-edged zip, shorter strapped brown boots. Plain blue hood back is visible under the white trim.
design_read.C3: Shoulder-length loose curls, burgundy underlayer and buttoned cream waistcoat. Open coat and two waist pouches remain visible from the front and quarter.
design_read.C4: Dark headband around short high curls, small hoops and a zipped closed coat. Longer lace-up brown boots and plain blue parka back.

material_fidelity.finding: Neutral rendering brings C2 forehead lightness to within 1.3 L* of the owner-derived guide. Its cheek sample remains about 6.8 L* lighter. C3/C4 cheek samples now read about 8.5 and 5.0 L* darker than their guides. Their brown mitten and blue sleeve samples are also darker in neutral light. Rendered concept lighting is unavailable and the approximation is not a color calibration of the original four-view scene.
material_fidelity.scope: Character identity verified by specific shapes, costume, and proportions. Material color and original studio lighting retain visible differences.
